agri.title: Agricultural intelligence
agri.subtitle: Soil, crop and irrigation intelligence linked to reviewed sources and acquisition times. Satellite indices complement measurements and agronomic review.
agri.liveNotice: This release processes supplied records. No live satellite or weather provider or automated image-diagnosis model is connected.
agri.recorded: Source records available; check date and method.
agri.satelliteNotice: Use surface reflectance from the same acquisition, normalized to 0–1 and aligned to a common spatial grid. Cloudy or invalid input produces no index. NDVI and LSWI do not identify a disease or measure N/P/K.
agri.irrigationNotice: Daily scenario: ETc = Kc × ETo; net = max(0, ETc − effective rain); gross = net / efficiency. Soil depletion, salinity and leaching are not modeled. Agronomic review is required; no equipment command is issued.
agri.diagnosisNotice: A reviewer records an observation against source evidence. Image diagnosis requires an attached image; there is no automated model or pesticide prescription.

publicExperience.ecosystemBody: FOGGARA draws on Algerian knowledge of resource management and sharing. This approach connects resources, data, equipment, producers, suppliers, experts and organizations.
publicExperience.evidenceBody: Data stays connected to its source and review status. Measurements, simulations and proposals remain distinct, and results retain their stated limits.

publicExperience.reviewBody: Separate data entry from approval and assign review to authorized roles, with rationale and audit records.
publicExperience.dataRoomBody: Organize disclosure of information and references through access requests and permissions, and track questions within the available workflow.
publicExperience.decisionTitle: Analysis informs decisions. People approve them.
publicExperience.decisionBody: Analyze alternatives, constraints and weights in the decision studio, then document approval and follow-up. Proposals remain separate from field commands and binding contracts.
publicExperience.ctaTitle: Your field needs are the starting point.
publicExperience.ctaBody: For producers, cooperatives, companies, laboratories, experts and institutions: build a collaboration workflow from a concrete problem to a measurable, reviewable result.
publicExperience.scope: Records labelled DEMO are illustrative. The scene is symbolic; external sources, field connectivity and accreditations require verification and actual configuration.

about.heading: Decision and operations platform
about.body: FOGGARA-DZ connects organisations, projects, sites, resources, measurements, evidence, review, decisions, actions and monitoring across Water, Energy, Food, Ecosystem and One Health. Operated by EURL SIREP OASES NEXUS WEFEH-DZ, Laghouat, Algeria.

about.heading: Working cycle
about.body: Resource → data → structure → analysis → rules → intelligence → decision → action → monitoring → evidence → learning. Results retain sources, methods and review states. The directory covers 69 wilayas; field operations depend on registered sites and projects.

privacy.heading: Controller and contact
privacy.body: Operator: EURL SIREP OASES NEXUS WEFEH-DZ. Privacy enquiries and rights: kacimo2000@gmail.com or the contact form. This policy does not claim an unverified ANPDP filing, authorisation or appointed data protection delegate.

privacy.heading: Data and purposes
privacy.body: Account and organisation data support access; sites, coordinates, projects, assets, analyses and documents support services; audit records support traceability and security. Contact submissions retain name, email, subject, message and reply consent. Enter only necessary personal data you are authorised to process.

privacy.heading: Access and disclosure
privacy.body: Server access checks enforce identity and organisation permissions. Published opportunities require explicit consent; data rooms use requests, access decisions and selected document disclosure. Curated references are public; organisation projects remain protected.

privacy.heading: Current hosting and transfers
privacy.body: This temporary release uses Render in Frankfurt and Supabase eu-central-1 outside Algeria. Transfers require assessment of lawfulness and applicable formalities under amended Law 18-07. Prepare required local hosting before entering sensitive data that requires local placement.

privacy.heading: Sessions and technical resources
privacy.body: The access token stays in memory and is removed on reload or logout. Language and wilaya preferences are stored locally. Fonts are served with the platform. This interface contains no advertising or marketing analytics tools.

privacy.heading: Artificial intelligence
privacy.body: Model connections are not enabled automatically. A configured private inference server receives selected organisation-scoped packets limited to needed data and references. Inputs, outputs and fingerprints are retained for review. Drafts grant no administrative access or equipment control.

privacy.heading: Retention and rights
privacy.body: Account and project records remain while their purpose or a legitimate retention obligation exists. This release has no automatic erasure; reviewed retention/erasure decisions must cover backups. Access, correction, erasure and objection requests can be recorded in the rights workspace or through contact, subject to identity and applicable obligations.

privacy.heading: Legal framework and complaints
privacy.body: Law 18-07 of 10 June 2018, amended by Law 25-11 of 24 July 2025. Complaints may be submitted to ANPDP. Original texts are linked in the reference centre; compliance depends on review of actual operator practices.

terms.heading: Access and use
terms.body: Use authorised accounts, protect credentials and enter data you have permission to use. Bypassing tenant isolation, misleading information and malicious content are prohibited. The organisation administrator manages members and roles.

terms.heading: Calculation and approval
terms.body: Calculations use declared inputs, units, methods and rules, retaining sources and limits. Specialists review decisions; equipment operation requires separate safety procedures. Economic scenarios do not guarantee funding or returns, and health indicators are not medical diagnoses.

terms.heading: Collaboration and contracts
terms.body: Matching connects needs and capabilities without automatically creating contracts, invoices or payments. Assurance records document actual business evidence; verify applicable signatures, contracts and taxation before binding transactions.

terms.heading: Availability and disputes
terms.body: Maintenance and hosting limits may interrupt service. Applicable professional agreements and mandatory rights prevail. Direct complaints to the operator; applicable laws and mandatory jurisdiction rules apply.

rights.heading: Data and content rights
rights.body: Owners retain their rights. Entering data permits processing needed for the service within purpose and permissions, without transferring ownership or allowing resale. Open-source components retain their licence terms.

rights.heading: Identity and references
rights.body: The SIREP OASES NEXUS WEFEH-DZ identity and crescent/star use the project’s supplied design. No unverified trademark registration or accreditation is claimed. References identify their publishers without implying platform endorsement.

rights.heading: Reporting
rights.body: Report content through contact with its link, the affected right and evidence of your standing. Reports are reviewed with protection of parties’ rights and data.
